description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 003 are a black and turquoise pool mosaic in small square pieces, shown in the product photo at night, for owners who want a bolder, more modern pool than a single blue.

## How they look
The photo pairs black and turquoise squares in one mosaic. Under pool lights at night the turquoise tends to glow while the black gives depth, so the pool reads as dark and dramatic rather than bright. In daylight the mix usually looks like a deep teal.

## Where they work
- **Modern pool tile design** for city houses and farmhouses with contemporary architecture.
- **Accent bands and feature walls** inside the pool, set against a plainer lining.
- **Lit pools used in the evening**, where two tone pool tiles make the most of underwater lights.

Dark pool tiles tend to absorb more sun, which some owners like for a slightly warmer feel, though water temperature depends on many things beyond the tile.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: black and turquoise square mosaic (from a night-time pool photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; the team confirms them with your quote.

Dark mosaics can show white scale marks if the water balance drifts, so keep the pool chemistry steady and use a pool-grade grout in a matching dark shade.

## See it before you order
See samples at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and look at it in daylight and under a lamp. Compare it with the plainer [dark blue mosaic 002](/products/swimming-pool-tiles-002), or browse the full [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of black and turquoise pool mosaic in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Do black pool tiles show dirt?
faqs.a: Dark tiles hide leaves and dust better than pale ones, but they can show white scale or chalky marks if the water chemistry is off. Regular testing and brushing keeps them looking even.

faqs.q: Is a two tone mosaic better than a single colour?
faqs.a: It depends on the style. A two tone mix adds texture and looks more modern; a single colour is calmer and easier to match with a border. Many owners use the mix on one wall or as a band.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
